svg.title: What the page does when it opens, in order
svg.desc: Six close-ups of the workspace, in order, each with a small map of the pane it shows. One, the page shows Loading R while webR starts. Two, the console lists the packages it installs. Three, the Files tab fills with the bundled files. Four, repl.startup-script runs once and its objects appear in the Environment tab. Five, the repl.auto-open files open in the editor. Six, the repl.auto-run files run and their plot appears in the Plots tab.
